_source.what: 装箱表 photographed by the client and sent 2026-09-04. A working shipping worksheet, not a specification document.
_source.columns: 序号 | 型号 | 包装 | 每箱数量 | 毛重(kg) | 净重(kg) | 箱规(cm) | 单箱体积(m³)
_source.columnNote: The two unlabelled numeric columns are read as gross and net weight: on every row the first is 0.9–1.1 kg higher than the second, which is a carton, and no other pair of quantities behaves that way. Stated here because the header was obscured in the photograph by a second sheet of paper lying across it.
_source.arithmeticCheck: 单箱体积 was recomputed from 箱规 for every row. 14 of 18 rows with both agree to the digit (49×20×35 → 0.0343, 47×25.5×14 → 0.016779, 31×21.6×16.4 → 0.01098144). Rows 3, 6, 22 and 23 do not, and are marked accordingly — the sheet's own volume was kept and the discrepancy recorded rather than silently corrected.
_source.transcribedBy: Claude, 2026-09-04, from the photograph. Not verified against the original spreadsheet.

_whyNotAppliedWholesale: FINISH CHANGES THE CARTON, on this sheet's own evidence. Rows 6 and 7 are 808 SS ET and 808 PB ET — the same lock in two finishes — at 57.2×19.1×47.5 and 42×35×31.8. Nothing about that is a rounding difference. So a packing row CANNOT be spread across a model's finish variants, which is what would have let 70710-AB cover 70710 PB and 70710 SN, and D101 cover its five finishes. That inference was the obvious shortcut and this sheet disproves it.

SEVERAL MODELS APPEAR TWICE WITH DIFFERENT PACKING. 607 SS ET is row 3 (吸塑 blister, 24 per carton, 44×40×39) and again in row 4 (纸盒 carton, 30 per carton, 49×20×35). 026 执手锁 is rows 22 and 23, at 24 and 16 per carton. 808 SSBK is rows 20 and 21, at 24 and 17. Which is current is not visible in the photograph, and a packing figure on a product page is quoted into a proforma and a bill of lading.

MOST ROWS ARE NOT OUR PRODUCTS. LOKSET, 坚士 575, 广城 70MM 锁芯, 江门 1119, 江门 0419 and DS05(余凯利) are other manufacturers' goods moving through the same warehouse. Rows 12-15 and 19 name a generic part (锁体50*85, 闭门器, 合页) rather than a model.
